t2.title: Cars be banned from city centers
t2.prompt: A student magazine announced an article writing contest. The best ones will be published in the magazine. Write your article on this topic: "Should cars be banned from city centers?" Write 180–200 words, giving reasons and examples.
t2.sample:
Traffic congestion and pollution plague many city centers worldwide. I believe restricting cars in urban cores is beneficial, though a complete ban may be too extreme.

Firstly, pedestrianized zones improve air quality and reduce noise pollution. Cities like Copenhagen have successfully created car-free areas that are now vibrant, pleasant spaces for residents and tourists alike.

Secondly, removing cars encourages public transport use and cycling, reducing carbon emissions. This supports environmental goals and promotes healthier lifestyles through more walking.

However, complete bans create problems. Businesses worry about losing customers, and elderly or disabled people who cannot walk or cycle would be disadvantaged. Delivery vehicles are also essential for shops and restaurants.

A better approach is congestion charging and creating more pedestrian zones while maintaining limited access for essential vehicles and those with mobility needs.

In conclusion, while complete car bans are impractical, reducing private vehicles in city centers benefits everyone. A balanced approach preserves accessibility while improving urban environments.

Dear ParkEasy Support,

I'm writing to give you some feedback on the ParkEasy app. Overall, I think it's quite useful. The real-time availability feature is helpful because I can see which parking spots are free before I drive there. The payment system is also convenient.

However, the app interface could be improved. Sometimes it's a bit confusing to navigate. Also, it would be great if the app showed the prices of different parking garages more clearly.

One feature that would be very useful is the ability to reserve a parking spot in advance. This would be especially helpful during busy times.

Thank you for asking for my opinion.

t2.sampleB2: Should Our City Centres Go Car-Free? Picture a city centre without the endless roar of engines — just people strolling, cyclists gliding past and clean air to breathe. It sounds like a dream, but should we actually ban cars from our urban hearts? In my view, we should, though with a few sensible exceptions. To begin with, banning cars would dramatically cut air pollution and noise. Streets that are currently choked with traffic could be turned into lively squares, cafés and green spaces where families genuinely want to spend time. Cities such as Oslo have already proved that this works wonders. On top of that, fewer cars would push people towards public transport, cycling and walking, which is far better for our health and the planet. Of course, we cannot ignore delivery drivers, emergency services and people with disabilities, who must still be allowed access. A blanket ban would simply be unfair to them. All things considered, I firmly believe that keeping cars out of city centres — while making room for those who truly need them — would make our cities cleaner, quieter and far more pleasant places to live.
t2.uzSample:
Butun dunyo bo'ylab ko'plab shahar markazlarini tirbandlik va ifloslanish qamrab olgan. Menimcha, shahar markazlarida avtomobillarni cheklash foydali, ammo to'liq taqiqlash juda ekstremal bo'lishi mumkin.

Birinchidan, piyodalar zonasi havo sifatini yaxshilaydi va shovqin ifloslanishini kamaytiradi. Kopengagen kabi shaharlar muvaffaqiyatli ravishda avtomobilsiz hududlarni yaratdi, ular hozirda aholi va sayyohlar uchun jonli, yoqimli joylardir.

Ikkinchidan, avtomobillarni olib tashlash jamoat transportidan foydalanishni va velosipedda yurishni rag'batlantiradi, bu esa karbonat angidrid chiqindilarini kamaytiradi. Bu ekologik maqsadlarni qo'llab-quvvatlaydi va ko'proq piyoda yurish orqali sog'lom turmush tarzini targ'ib qiladi.

Biroq, to'liq taqiqlar muammolarni keltirib chiqaradi. Korxonalar mijozlarni yo'qotishdan xavotirda va piyoda yoki velosipedda yura olmaydigan keksa yoki nogiron odamlar zarar ko'radi. Yetkazib berish transport vositalari ham do'konlar va restoranlar uchun zarur.

Yaxshiroq yondashuv - bu tirbandlik uchun to'lov undirish va ko'proq piyodalar zonalarini yaratish, shu bilan birga zarur transport vositalari va harakatlanishga muhtoj bo'lganlar uchun cheklangan kirishni saqlab qolishdir.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, avtomobillarni to'liq taqiqlash amaliy bo'lmasa-da, shahar markazlarida shaxsiy transport vositalarini kamaytirish hamma uchun foydalidir. Muvozanatli yondashuv shahar muhitini yaxshilash bilan birga qulaylikni saqlaydi.

Hurmatli ParkEasy qo'llab-quvvatlash xizmati,

Sizga ParkEasy ilovasi bo'yicha ba'zi fikr-mulohazalarimni bildirish uchun yozyapman. Umuman olganda, menimcha, u juda foydali. Real vaqt rejimida mavjudlik funksiyasi juda qo'l keladi, chunki men u yerga mashina haydashdan oldin qaysi to'xtash joylari bo'sh ekanligini ko'rishim mumkin. To'lov tizimi ham qulay.

Biroq, ilova interfeysini yaxshilash mumkin. Ba'zan navigatsiya qilish biroz chalkash. Bundan tashqari, agar ilova turli to'xtash joylarining narxlarini aniqroq ko'rsatsa, juda yaxshi bo'lardi.

Juda foydali bo'ladigan bir funksiya - bu oldindan to'xtash joyini bron qilish imkoniyati. Bu, ayniqsa, band paytlarda juda foydali bo'ladi.

Fikrimni so'raganingiz uchun rahmat.

Hurmat bilan,
Gulnora Yusupova
t2.uzSampleB2:
Hurmatli ParkEasy qo'llab-quvvatlash jamoasi,

Men ParkEasy ilovasidan foydalanish tajribam haqida fikr-mulohazalarimni bildirish uchun yozyapman. Men real vaqt rejimida avtoturargoh mavjudligi va integratsiyalashgan to'lov tushunchasini chinakam innovatsion va, asosan, yaxshi amalga oshirilgan deb bilaman. Bu, albatta, shaharda avtoturargoh topishning ko'pincha asabiylashtiradigan jarayonini soddalashtirdi.

Ilova interfeysiga kelsak, umuman olganda foydalanuvchilar uchun qulay bo'lsa-da, menimcha, vizual aniqlik nuqtai nazaridan takomillashtirish uchun imkoniyat bor. Xarita, ayniqsa, zich joylashgan hududlarda yuqori aniqlikdagi tasvirlardan foydalanishi mumkin. Bundan tashqari, foydalanuvchilarga o'z manziliga maksimal yurish masofasini belgilash imkonini beruvchi filtr opsiyasi qimmatli qo'shimcha bo'ladi.

Qo'shimcha funksiyalarga kelsak, men foydalanuvchilarga turli joylardagi avtoturargoh narxlarini real vaqt rejimida solishtirish imkonini beruvchi funksiyani integratsiya qilishni taklif qilaman. Bundan tashqari, tez-tez foydalanuvchilarni chegirmali avtoturargoh narxlari bilan taqdirlaydigan sodiqlik dasturi mijozlarni ushlab qolishni sezilarli darajada oshirishi mumkin. Nihoyat, individual avtoturargoh joylari uchun foydalanuvchilarning sharhlari va reytinglarini kiritish boshqa haydovchilar uchun qimmatli ma'lumot berishi mumkin.

ParkEasy tajribasini yaxshilashga sodiqligingiz uchun tashakkur.

Hurmat bilan,
Gulnora Yusupova

t12.title: formal letter · to recipient
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the parking app company. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t12.sample: Dear ParkEasy Support, Thank you for inquiring about my experience with your parking app. I am very pleased with how ParkEasy has simplified my parking routine. The real-time availability feature is incredibly accurate, and the contactless payment saves considerable time. The interface is clean and intuitive. However, I have some suggestions. The app sometimes doesn't show parking prices until you arrive, which makes budgeting difficult. I would appreciate upfront pricing on the map view. Additionally, the app occasionally crashes when GPS signal is weak. Improving offline functionality would be helpful. I would also love a feature to reserve parking in advance for events. A loyalty rewards system for frequent users would be a welcome addition. Overall, ParkEasy has reduced my parking stress significantly. Yours sincerely, Gulnora Yusupova

t12.sampleB2: Dear ParkEasy Support Team, I am writing in response to your request for feedback on the ParkEasy app, which I have been using for the past few months. I also find the interface clean and easy to navigate. That said, there is room for improvement. The app rarely displays parking charges before I arrive, which makes it hard to plan ahead. I would strongly recommend adding upfront pricing to the map. Furthermore, an option to reserve a space in advance would be a welcome addition, particularly during busy periods. Thank you for taking my comments on board. Yours faithfully, Dilnoza Karimova
